name: Silent Pathways Playtest
detailed_description:
PLAYTEST VERSION - MIGHT CHANGE

The last traces of your memories slip away into darkness. You can’t remember why you’ve returned, but something is pulling you to the house. Something is watching you. You must uncover the truth before it breaks you.

Awaken...

Silent Pathways is a first-person psychological horror game that delves into the darkness of a family’s past. You return to your childhood home, a place that should feel familiar, but it’s twisted with disturbing memories. The house is alive with echoes of something that won’t let you forget what happened on that fateful day in 1965. Every corner holds secrets, and every step brings you closer to the truth or your descent into madness.

Explore...

As Dave, you will search through the decaying remnants of the house, piecing together clues, diary entries, and unsettling flashbacks that reveal a dark history. But the house isn’t just a building, it’s a reflection of the horrors lurking within your mind. With every discovery, the lines between past and present blur, and the deeper you go, the more you question what’s real.

Experience...

Immerse yourself in a fully realized world, where every creak of the floorboards, every flicker of the lights, and every whisper of the wind is designed to keep you on edge. The house feels alive with cutting-edge graphics and dynamic sound design, with each room more haunting than the last. Your mind is your worst enemy as you confront the terrifying memories that refuse to stay buried.

short_description: Drawn back to his home, Dave searches for closure in the decaying remnants of his past. But the house is not as he remembers—shadows linger where they shouldn't, whispers echo through the halls, and buried memories refuse to stay forgotten. Explore the abandoned home and a past that won’t let go.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10
  • Processor: Intel Core i7-6700K | AMD Ryzen 5 3600
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA® GeForce® GTX 1070 Ti or AMD Radeon™ RX 5700 or Intel® Arc™ A750
  • Storage: 3 GB available space
  • Sound Card: Windows Compatible Audio Device.
  • Additional Notes: Playing on minimum requirements should enable to play on Low/Medium quality settings in FullHD (1080p) in stable 30 FPS. SSD is recommended.
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10
  • Processor: Intel Core i7-8700K | AMD Ryzen 5 3600X
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA® GeForce® RTX 3050Ti or NVIDIA® GeForce® 2080RTX or AMD Radeon™ 6800XT
  • Storage: 3 GB available space
  • Sound Card: Windows Compatible Audio Device.
  • Additional Notes: Playing on recommended requirements should enable to play on Medium quality settings in 60 FPS or High quality settings in 30 FPS, in FullHD (or 4k using DLSS or similar technology). SSD is recommended.
